https://i.imgur.com/J22zgQF.jpg

The solution to this problem
[olist]
 I changed the type of old version item to 'Lock!! Spooky Gift Box'. 
 I will have  NPC to exchange items (from Lock!! Spooky Gift Box ===> The New Spooky Gift Box) in a couple of days. And 'The New Spooky Gift Box' CAN EXPORT

Sorry for the inconvenience

notes.title: Devblog#11 Update v0.1.2 Buy & Sell items to NPC Shop
notes.notes:
Buy Items from Halloween Shop
https://i.imgur.com/m8zGECt.jpg?1

 Pumpkin Seeds - Use this item to grow pumpkins in the plant box.
 Fertilizer - Use this to reduce the planting time for 2 hr. And can use for all plants to be added after this.
 Spooky Gift Box - This item can export to the Steam Inventory. When opened, will receive the items inside. (The received items and rate of opening items in the box I will show in the next update).
 Pumpkin Pie - This item restores your HP +50 points.  
 Pumpkin Jam - This item restores your SP +50 points.  

* [Spooky Gift Box,  Pumpkin Pie, Pumpkin Jam]: These items can buy only at Halloween Event (Halloween Shop will close on 20 November 2020).
** [Spooky Gift Box]: Buying this item from the shop, It will be sent to your LoopEx Warehouse and prepare to export to World Marketplace(Steam Inventory) in the next update. 

Sell Items to The Farmer Truck
https://i.imgur.com/HE5NwV4.jpg
For selling, I decided to add gameplay to sell items. Players have to pick up the items from storage and go to sell at the NPC. And I will add gameplay the same this to grow and apply manure for the plant replace click on the widget in the future update.

Planning for the next update
https://i.imgur.com/8JTaQDn.jpg

 Export Items from LoopEx Warehouse to World Marketplace(Steam Inventory).
 Open Gift Items on World Marketplace(Steam Inventory).


See you next update.

notes.title: Devblog#9 The New Update & Halloween Event
notes.notes:
The New Update & Roadmap
Hello all players. After a long time away, I came back to update this game again. In this version, I have changed the map to 'The Local Farm' map. This map you will play in the single-player mode. Later updates I plan for the players to can buy and sell items to NPC, decorate your farm, grow many fruits and vegetables, and fight with monsters. All items received will be stored on the server. There will be some items that can craft and export to the Stream Inventory. However, in this mode, you can not meet the other players until the Multiplayer mode has been updated. I expect it will take about 14 months from now. I have a friend who owns the Villages™ (AKA simonjames247) will take over as an Engineer to develop that mode and I will change my role to Game Designer and determine the direction of this game.

In this update (Halloween Event)
https://i.imgur.com/jvlxA6X.jpg
This update is just around Halloween. So I invite the players to grow pumpkins in the glasshouse. The pumpkins plant in the plant box and take 12 hours to grow before harvest. The product will receive 12 Pumpkins and 1 Shell (A new currency that will use to buy the item in this map and cosmetic things). For the first time, the pumpkin seeds will give away from the system 30 each. And the next update v.0.1.2, I will add the shop to let players purchase more pumpkin seeds and New Halloween Collection items. 

Don't worry about the old version items
The items from the old game version(Log, Scrap Stone, Wood, Brick) are store in the server not deleted. I will plan to convert them to a new database in later updates.
